text.p: Typhoon Opal is strengthening and gaining speed towards the north in the western Pacific. It now has winds of 100 mph and is located well east of the northern Philippines and about 600 miles south-southeast of Okinawa. It is expected to have winds up to 130 mph in 24-48 hours as it tracks east of Okinawa and towards Shikoku Japan. This system will become an increasing risk to shipping as it moves northward. It is expected to reach Shikoku Japan in about 60 hours with winds of 115-120 mph. Should this track hold the island would experience very heavy rains leading to flooding and possible mudslides. It would also have damaging winds and a storm surge when landfall occurs.
There are no further statements at this time.
